title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: Calls for separate, sufficient and clearly ringfenced funding for the CAP, the common fisheries policy, the cohesion policy and the European Social Fund to enhance long-term territorial resilience, social cohesion and trust in the European project as well as upwards convergence;
